pdf_c_best_pace2: Average pace over the valid laps is {gap} s off the best lap, with a standard deviation of {sigma} s across {n} laps.
pdf_c_no_corner_loss: No corner loses a significant amount of time against the reference lap.
pdf_c_deg_lowconf: The pace trend is inconclusive: only {n} valid laps are available to estimate it (low confidence).
pdf_c_deg_none: No significant pace degradation: the slope interval ({ci} s/lap) includes zero.
pdf_c_deg_rate: Estimated pace degradation of {rate} s/lap, after removing the fuel effect.
pdf_c_inconsistent_corner: Corner {n} is the least repeatable, with a {s} s spread between laps.
pdf_c_fuel: Average consumption of {rate} L/lap; fuel for about {laps} more laps.
pdf_c_cmp_identical: {a} and {b} have practically identical lap times.
pdf_c_cmp_split: In corners: {c} s; between corners: {o} s.
pdf_c_cmp_balance: Balance in {lap}: {us} % of the time understeering and {os_} % oversteering.
pdf_a_run_stint: Analyse the full stint (at least 3 laps) to get pace, degradation and recommendations.
pdf_focus_braking: Work on the braking point and brake pressure
pdf_focus_apex: Improve minimum speed and line at the apex
pdf_focus_exit: Get on the throttle earlier and stabilise the exit
pdf_cap_lap_times: Each point is a lap. Pit and outlier laps (hollow circles) are excluded from pace. The shaded band is the P10 to P90 range of the projection.
pdf_cap_lap_table: {n_clean} of {n_total} laps are valid for pace and consistency. The gap to best is only computed for valid laps.
pdf_intro_corners_session: Time lost or gained per corner by the session's average lap relative to the reference lap (positive = loses, negative = gains).
pdf_intro_corners_compare: Time lost or gained per corner by {b} relative to {a} (positive = {b} loses, negative = {b} gains).
pdf_cap_corner_bars: Corners in track order. Error bars show the spread between laps: the larger the bar, the less repeatable the technique in that corner.
pdf_no_priority: No corner shows a relevant loss (more than 0.02 s).
pdf_cap_corner_table_session: Δ versus the reference lap: positive brake = brakes later, positive apex = faster at the apex, positive throttle = gets on the power later. Minor differences are omitted. σ = spread between laps.
pdf_cap_corner_table_compare: Δ of {b} versus {a}: positive brake = brakes later, positive apex = faster at the apex, positive throttle = gets on the power later. Minor differences are omitted.
pdf_setup_summary: Recommendations identified: {n}. Total potential gain: {gain} s/lap if all are applied optimally.
pdf_setup_none: No setup recommendations are available for this data.
pdf_setup_disclaimer: Gains are theoretical ranges and do not add up linearly. Apply changes incrementally and verify on track.
pdf_reason_insufficient_sample: Insufficient sample: the trend is estimated from very few valid laps and the projection is flat around recent pace.
pdf_reason_wide_slope_ci: The slope uncertainty is high: the projection is indicative only.
pdf_reason_wear_inactive: The simulator does not expose a tyre wear channel.
pdf_reason_no_degradation: Lap times show no upward trend that can be told apart from noise.
pdf_reason_low_conf_generic: The estimate has low confidence: treat the projection as indicative.
pdf_cap_projection: Statistical projection (Monte Carlo simulation) for the next laps.
pdf_cap_projection_low: Low confidence: the projection is indicative and should not drive strategy decisions.
pdf_track_improving: The track is gaining grip: {s} s of improvement over the session.
pdf_track_degrading: The track is losing grip: {s} s of deterioration over the session.
pdf_track_stable: The track stays stable during the session.
pdf_strategy_none: No strategy data is available for this session.
pdf_cap_tyre_session: Session-wide averages; the camber gradient is the difference between the inner and outer edge of the tread.
pdf_cap_tech_session: Averages over {n} laps. Only channels available in the file are shown.
pdf_cap_speed: Where each lap carries more speed. Sharp drops are braking zones; a higher minimum speed in a corner usually means a better exit speed.
pdf_cap_delta: Cumulative time difference metre by metre. The steepest slopes mark where the lap is decided.
pdf_cap_brake_throttle: Brake pressure (top) and throttle (bottom). Later braking or earlier throttle indicates more confidence.
pdf_cap_gg: Lateral against longitudinal acceleration. The more the outer edge is filled, the more of the available grip is used.
pdf_cap_tyres: Mean surface temperature per tyre. Green = working window; amber or red = overtemperature; blue = cold tyre.
pdf_cap_brake_fade: Ratio of deceleration to brake pressure. A falling curve indicates fade; shaded areas are the detected segments.
pdf_cap_nerv: Frequency of steering corrections. Values above 0.5 indicate an unstable car or a driver at the limit.
pdf_cap_susp: Front and rear roll (top) and pitch (bottom). More front roll points to mechanical understeer; more rear roll, to oversteer.
pdf_cap_slip: Top, sideslip angle β. Bottom, αF-αR balance: above +2° means structural understeer; below -2°, oversteer.
pdf_q_none: No relevant data limitations were detected for this session.
pdf_q_more: {n} more notices in the final section.
pdf_q_synthetic_distance: The distance channel was synthesised from speed. Braking and position differences may carry an error of 5 to 15 m.
pdf_q_no_stint: The stint analysis (pace, degradation, fuel and recommendations) is not included; it needs at least 3 laps.
pdf_q_short_session: Short session ({n} laps): trends and consistency are unreliable.
pdf_q_no_corners: The corners of this session could not be analysed; that section is omitted.
pdf_q_deg_lowconf: The pace projection has low confidence ({n} usable laps; at least {min} are recommended). Use it as guidance only.
pdf_q_no_fuel: There is no fuel channel: consumption and the pit window are not calculated.
pdf_q_wear_inactive: The simulator does not expose tyre wear: there is no wear model.
pdf_q_bias_range: Brake bias ({v} %) is outside the typical range ({lo} to {hi} %): check the risk of fade or lock-up.
pdf_q_modules_missing: Analyses unavailable because of missing channels: {items}.
pdf_q_health_critical: Several analysis modules lack enough data: results are partial.
pdf_limits_general: The analyses are estimates based on the available telemetry. They support the engineer's and the driver's decisions and do not replace on-track verification.
pdf_no_data: There is not enough data to generate the report.
pdf_no_conclusions: There is not enough data to draw conclusions.
pdf_no_actions: No recommendations are available for this data.
api_err_pdf_payload: The session report needs the session analysis result ('session' field with the lap list).
